purpose: IMP-02 independent expected extraction for elden_ring_detail.min.html + elden_ring_user_*.min.html; authored by reading the raw live response before the parser existed, per SPK-02/SPK-03 and the non-negotiable 'curated observations are not parser input' rule

sanitisation.method: kept the JSON-LD <script> and the hero developer/user-score DOM fragments byte-verbatim; the __NUXT_DATA__ payload is a single positionally-indexed JSON array (Nuxt's flattened/dedup format) so it was re-serialised with every array slot not reachable from the game/platform fields this parser reads replaced by null, preserving the original indices and values of everything that IS read; the JSON-LD description was truncated to a 24-word excerpt (same excerpt_policy as the SPK-02 curated fixtures)

game.title: Elden Ring
game.description_excerpt: A New World Created By Hidetaka Miyazaki And George R. R. Martin ELDEN RING, developed by FromSoftware, Inc. and BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment Inc., is [...]

platforms.name: PlayStation 5
platforms.userscore_source: hero widget embedded in elden_ring_detail.min.html itself (lead platform, no separate fetch needed)

observed_anomaly: The live detail page's own hero Metascore widget (a client-hydrated DOM element, not the __NUXT_DATA__ payload) rendered 'Metascore TBD' for the PlayStation 5 lead platform at capture time, even though the same response's JSON-LD aggregateRating (ratingValue 96, reviewCount 93) and the __NUXT_DATA__ platforms array (score 96, reviewCount 93) agree the value is 96. This is a real, independently-confirmed source inconsistency (SPK-02 already flagged similar hero/JSON-LD count drift for this game) and is why the parser reads the structured __NUXT_DATA__ platform record rather than the display widget for Metascore.
user_reviews_path_rule: not a literal payload field; constructed by substituting the platform slug into the same '/game/<game-slug>/user-reviews/?platform=<platform-slug>' template already confirmed as a stable route contract by SPK-02, mirroring how critic_reviews_path is read
verification_note: cross-checked against the independently-captured SPK-02/SPK-03 spike fixtures (multiplatform-game.json, identity-cases.json): source_game_id 1300501979, all 5 source_platform_id/source_game_platform_id pairs, cover_url, trailer URLs and the full description SHA-256 are byte-identical to the 2026-09-06 spike capture; only review/user counts (not recorded here) would be expected to drift over time
